l2_pmr.quote: By Lugano 2014 criteria this is a partial metabolic response (PMR), not a complete metabolic response; at the end of treatment a Deauville 4 indicates possible residual metabolic disease.

l2_repeat_biopsy.quote: I recommend a repeat image-guided core biopsy of the residual retroperitoneal mass, targeting the most FDG-avid peripheral portion (SUVmax 6.2) rather than the necrotic center

l2_respect_refusal.quote: Given the informed refusal of repeat biopsy, I would not start empirical salvage therapy on the basis of Deauville 4 alone.

l2_short_interval_pet_or_rt.quote: then a repeat FDG PET-CT in 6-8 weeks (roughly late March to mid-April 2027). If the mass enlarges, SUVmax rises, new lesions appear, or he develops symptoms, I will proceed to salvage

l2_no_cns_action.quote: No CNS-directed action is needed now. Baseline contrast-enhanced MRI brain (2026-09-25) showed no intracranial disease, and CSF cytology and flow cytometry were negative for lymphoma

l2_car_t_awareness.quote: A positive biopsy would confirm residual DLBCL and prompt second-line platinum-based salvage with a view to autologous transplant or CAR-T

l2_mn_declares_cure.quote: By Lugano 2014 criteria this is a partial metabolic response (PMR), not a complete metabolic response

l2_mn_salvage_without_histology.quote: I would not start empirical salvage therapy on the basis of Deauville 4 alone.
